text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A mock race was scheduled to take place today.
Having some free time, I decided to go watch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When suddenly—

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho-san! Head to the track immediately!
The mock race is about to start!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...No way.

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Why now of all times...!
You registered for this race yourself—!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...No. I don't wanna run.
Leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Good grief, throwing a tantrum as usual, are we?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What, did you come here to tell me to run too?
Just so you know, it's totally useless.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm completely not in the mood.
When I say I'm not running, I'm not running.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mood, is it?
In that case, I have a splendid solution.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Look, Sweep.
Don't you want this?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Wait, could that be—!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sweep's not coming, is she?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Looked like they were squabblin' up there.
Even if she does show, she probably won't be in top shape.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I suppose so... Well, guess I can just consider it
one less rival to keep an eye on.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, whatever works.
I'm gonna beat ya into the dust either way!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh? What, you showed up after all?
Looks like we can finally get this party started!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While the other racers waited impatiently, Sweep Tosho
finally took her position.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet surges forward!
Vodka pulls up alongside her! Will this turn into
a fierce head-to-head clash between the two—?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Today's victory is MIIIINE!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No, it's MIIIIIIINE, ORAAA!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fierce duel for the lead. It seemed impossible
for anyone to cut between them, but—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Wha—?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Counting Scarlet and Vodka,
there are 5 people ahead, 4 people, 3 people—!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (If I get serious from here—it's a total breeze!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: The one who wins in the end... IS MEEEEEE!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...! 
—Alright!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that?!
That is the true power of the Magical Girl Sweepy!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No way... Weren't you
completely unmotivated just a moment ago?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, I just got in the mood, that's all!
Because Air Groove-san promised to give me "that"
before the race!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Wait, could that be—!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
It's the flower seeds you've wanted for quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —I want it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You'll give them to me if I run properly, right?!
Then I'm gonna give it everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Flower, seeds?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What the hell, you got crazy strong all of a sudden
just over some flower seeds?!
That makes no damn sense!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What doesn't make sense about it?!
Besides, what's wrong with flower seeds?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I was certain she'd never catch up,
but to charge up from that position...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...She really isn't someone to be underestimated, that girl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A terrifying late surge unleashed by a mere shift in mood.
Perhaps the world really could be moved
by the fleeting whim of a young girl.
